item.title: Trader Joe's chicken fried rice recalled for possibly containing glass
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food Safety and Inspection Service and Ajinomoto Foods North America, Inc., based in Portland, Ore., announced a recall for approximately 3,370,530 pounds of frozen not ready-to-eat chicken fried rice products possibly contaminated with glass.
